issues.where: terrain segment, frames 2490 to 2669, near cliff and far canyon rim
issues.what: The terrain view has no depth. The near cliff and the far rim and horizon move the same distance (about 20 px left), so the view reads as a still matte being panned, not a flight over ground. The near ground never moves against the horizon.
issues.fix: Drive the terrain shot with real camera translation over a depth or height field, or layer the plate so the near ground moves faster than the far rim and horizon, which stay almost fixed. Add a slow forward push so the foreground moves in perspective.

issues.what: There is almost no life in the terrain view. The low dust in the valley and the haze at the horizon sit frozen for about 180 frames. Nothing flows.
issues.fix: Add slow drifting dust or haze layers across the valley floor and along the horizon glow, each at its own speed by depth, with no visible loop.

issues.what: The globe does not turn. The swirl, the craters and the canyon system stay at the same pixels for 150 frames while the moon crosses in front, so the planet reads as a static disc.
issues.fix: Add a slow axial rotation to the planet texture during hold, with the cloud swirl drifting a little faster than the ground.

issues.what: Stars burst out as a bright cluster of sparkles through the top of the thinning dust before the sky has cleared. This reads as a speckle pop, not stars coming out from behind haze.
issues.fix: Fade star brightness in by the same transmittance as the dust layer, so stars only appear where the haze has cleared, smoothly over several frames.

issues.what: The horizon goes from a strongly curved, raised orbital limb at 2449 to a flat, lower terrain horizon at 2458. The dust hides most of this, but the curvature and height change is visible in 2450 and 2458.
issues.fix: Match the terrain plate's horizon height and slight curvature to the end of the dive, or let the dive camera flatten and lower the limb before the dust peaks.

issues.where: dive, frames 2416 to 2424, and rise frames 2710 to 2717 in sheet-05.png
issues.what: The zoom blur is very heavy and smeared toward one side. It stays smooth with no ghost copies, but at 2424 and 2710 the surface turns to mush for several frames, which weakens the sense of a real place.
issues.fix: Lower the peak radial blur strength by about 30 to 40 percent and keep the canyon system readable through the fastest frames.
